owns.description: Recorded ownership; person first, service second.

views.ve_strict: for every service x0, (if (x0 is deployed), then (there exists person x1, (x1 owns x0))).
views.ve_natural: for every service x0: (if (x0 is deployed), then (there is a person x1 such that (x1 owns x0))).
views.ve_fluent: for every service S that is deployed, there is a person P such that P owns S.

fluent_variables.rule: Distinct sort letters exclude A/I/O and declared identifiers (case-insensitive). Choose the noun initial, then its unused consonants, then BCDEFGHJKLMNPQRSTUVWXYZ; on exhaustion use alphabetic codes BB, BC, ... . Within the naming scope, each sort's named binders use suffixes 1, 2, ... in preorder; omit 1. Constants have @; lexical words are lowercase.

legend.naming_rule: Allocate binders in preorder. Restart names in each statement.
